40015753.author: पदार्थः
40015753.content: तेषाम् their, वानररक्षसाम् Vanara and Rakshasa, युध्यतामेव battling, तदा then, रविः sun, अस्तम् set, गतः went, प्राणहारिणी harmful to the life, रात्रिः night, प्रवृत्ता began.

40015753.author: Translation
40015753.content: Thus, as the Vanaras and Rakshasas were battling, the Sun began to set, which is not favourable to the life of Vanaras.

40015754.author: पदार्थः
40015754.content: तदा then, अन्योन्यम् to one another, बद्धवैराणाम् strong enmity, घोराणाम् dreadful, जयम् victory, इच्छताम् wishing, वानररक्षसाम् Vanara and Rakshasas, निशायुद्धम् night battle, सम्प्रवृत्तम् started.

40015754.author: Translation
40015754.content: Then Vanaras and dreadful Rakshasas being strongly inimical to each other started the night battle wishing victory.

40015755.author: पदार्थः
40015755.content: दारुणे fierce, तस्मिन् them, तमसि darkness, राक्षसःअसि thinking to be Rakshasa, इति thus, हरयः monkeys, हरिश्च and monkeys, असि thinking to be, इति thus, राक्षसाः Rakshasa, समरे fought, अन्योन्यम् one another, जघ्नुः hit .

40015755.author: Translation
40015755.content: In the fierce darkness that prevailed, monkeys hit monkeys thinking to be Rakshasas and Rakshasas hit Rakshasas thinking to be Vanaras (not knowing in darkness) hit each other.

40015756.author: पदार्थः
40015756.content: जहिदारय strike, चैहीति tear, कथं how, विद्रवसीतिच why do you run away, एवं in this manner, सुतुमुलश्शब्द loud echo, स्तस्मिं such was, स्तमसि darkness, शुश्रुवे heard, तस्मिन् such was, तमसि dark complexioned, कालाः night, काञ्चनसन्नाहाः covered with golden armour, राक्षसाः Rakshasa, दीप्तौषधिवनाः shining like the herbs in the forests, शैलेन्द्राः mountain, सम्प्रदृश्यन्त appeared.

40015756.author: Translation
40015756.content: "Strike", "Tear", "Why are you running away?" were the kind of tumultuous echo heard in the darkness of the night. In that darkness the dark complexioned Vanaras and Rakshasas covered with golden armour in the night seemed like shining herbs of the forest in the mountain.

40015757.author: पदार्थः
40015757.content: जहिदारय strike, चैहीति tear, कथं how, विद्रवसीतिच why do you run away, एवं in this manner, सुतुमुलश्शब्द loud echo, स्तस्मिं such was, स्तमसि darkness, शुश्रुवे heard, तस्मिन् such was, तमसि dark complexioned, कालाः night, काञ्चनसन्नाहाः covered with golden armour, राक्षसाः Rakshasa, दीप्तौषधिवनाः shining like the herbs in the forests, शैलेन्द्राः mountain, सम्प्रदृश्यन्त appeared.

40015757.author: Translation
40015757.content: "Strike", "Tear", "Why are you running away?" were the kind of tumultuous echo heard in the darkness of the night. In that darkness the dark complexioned Vanaras and Rakshasas covered with golden armour in the night seemed like shining herbs of the forest in the mountain.

40015758.author: पदार्थः
40015758.content: दुष्पारे difficult to penetrate, तस्मिन् in that, तमसि darkness, क्रोधमूर्छिता lost senses overcome by anger, राक्षसाः Rakshasas, प्लवङ्गमान् monkeys, भक्षयन्तः devouring, महावेगाः swiftly, परिपेतुः wandered.

40015758.author: Translation
40015758.content: In that pitch darkness, which was difficult even to move, the Rakshasas overcome by anger and lost senses were wandering devouring the monkeys.

40015759.author: पदार्थः
40015759.content: भीमकोपाः terribly angry, बलिनः mighty strong, तेवानराः those Vanaras, आप्लुत्य springing up, तीक्ष्णैः their sharp, धवनैः teeth, काञ्चनापीडान् golden ornaments, हयान् horses, आशीविषोपमान् pervading like fire, ध्वजांश्च of the horses, व्यदारयन् splitting, युद्धे in battle, राक्षसीम् Rakshasa's, चमूम् , अक्षोभयन् tore to pieces.

40015759.author: Translation
40015759.content: The mighty strong Vanaras, terribly angry at the Rakshasas sprang up to the sky, and tore with their sharp teeth, the horses of Rakshasas decked with golden ornaments pervading like fire in the battle.

40015760.author: पदार्थः
40015760.content: व्यदारयन् lost sense with anger, कुञ्जरान् elephants, कुञ्जरारोहान् mounted on elephants, पताकाध्वजिनः posts tied with flags, रथान् chariots, चकर्षुः dragged them, दशनैः with teeth, ददंशुश्च destroyed.

40015760.author: Translation
40015760.content: Having lost senses in fury they dragged the elephants, those mounted upon them, and the chariots decorated with posts and flags and tore them with their teeth.

40015761.author: पदार्थः
40015761.content: रामश्च Rama as well, लक्ष्मणश्चापि as Lakshmana also, आशीविषोपमैः shining like venomous snakes, शरैः arrows, दृश्यादृश्यानि visible and invisible, प्रवराणि principal, रक्षांसि Rakshasas, निजघ्नतुः killed

40015761.author: Translation
40015761.content: Then Rama as well as Lakshmana with their venomous snakelike arrows killed both visible and invisible principal Rakshasas.

40015762.author: पदार्थः
40015762.content: तुरङ्गखुरविध्वस्तम् pulverised by the horses hooves, रथनेमिसमुत्थितम् crushed by the wheels of chariots, धरणीरजः dust from the ground, युध्यताम् risen, कर्णनेत्राणि ears and eyes, रुरोध filled.

40015762.author: Translation
40015762.content: Then the dust rose from the ground pulverised the horses' hooves and crushed by the chariot wheels, filling the ears and eyes of those in war.

40015763.author: पदार्थः
40015763.content: तथा like that, घोरे terrible, रोमहर्षणे horripilation, सङ्ग्रामे war, वर्तमाने moving, रुधिरोधा river of blood, महाघोराः terrific, नद्यः noise, तत्र there, प्रसुस्रुवुः flowed.

40015763.author: Translation
40015763.content: In that way as the war was going on, and rivers of blood flowing with the terrific noise it made hair stand on end.

40015764.author: पदार्थः
40015764.content: ततः there, भेरीमृदङ्गानाम् kettle drums and wooden drums, पणवानांच musical instrument panava, शङ्खवेणुस्वनोमनिश्रः sounds of conchs, flutes mixed, अद्भुतोपमः wonderful, निस्स्वनः rattling sounds, सम्बभूव arose.

40015764.author: Translation
40015764.content: There arose wonderful sounds of musical instruments, the sounds of kettle drums, wooden drums, mixed with conchs and flutes.

40015765.author: पदार्थः
40015765.content: अत्र there, स्तनमानानाम् in the battlefield, हतानाम् wounded, राक्षसानांच Rakshasas, शस्तानाम् appeased, वानराणांच and Vanaras, दारुणः dreadful, निःस्वनः roaring sounds, सम्बभूव arose.

40015765.author: Translation
40015765.content: There from the battlefield arose the roaring sounds of wounded and appeased Rakshasas and Vanaras.

40015766.author: पदार्थः
40015766.content: तत्र there, शस्त्रपुष्पोपहारा offering of flowers dropped from enemies (from the mountain), युद्धमेदिनी on the battlefield, हतैः killed, वानरवीरैश्च Vanara warriors also, शक्तिशूलपरश्वधैः by javelins, tridents and axes, निहतैः wounded, कामरूपिभिः who can change their form at will, पर्वताकारैः of mountain size, राक्षसैः Rakshasa, शोणितास्रावकर्दमा wetted by the flow of blood, दुर् ज्ञेया muddy, दुर्निवेशाच difficult to reach, आसीत् remained.

40015766.author: Translation
40015766.content: There with warriors of Vanaras wounded by javelins, tridents and axes, and the Rakshasas of mountain size who could change their form at will, the battlefield was muddy, and wet with blood flowing and difficult to reach.

40015767.author: पदार्थः
40015767.content: तत्र there, शस्त्रपुष्पोपहारा offering of flowers dropped from enemies (from the mountain), युद्धमेदिनी on the battlefield, हतैः killed, वानरवीरैश्च Vanara warriors also, शक्तिशूलपरश्वधैः by javelins, tridents and axes, निहतैः wounded, कामरूपिभिः who can change their form at will, पर्वताकारैः of mountain size, राक्षसैः Rakshasa, शोणितास्रावकर्दमा wetted by the flow of blood, दुर् ज्ञेया muddy, दुर्निवेशाच difficult to reach, आसीत् remained.

40015767.author: Translation
40015767.content: There with warriors of Vanaras wounded by javelins, tridents and axes, and the Rakshasas of mountain size who could change their form at will, the battlefield was muddy, and wet with blood flowing and difficult to reach.

40015768.author: पदार्थः
40015768.content: सर्वेषाम् for all beings, भूतानाम् beings, दुरतिक्रमा difficult to pass, कालरात्रीव like the night of dissolution, सानिशा that night, घोरा fierce, हरिराक्षसनाशिनी destructive to Vanaras and Rakshasas, बभूव remained.

40015768.author: Translation
40015768.content: Like the dreadful night for all beings, difficult to spend, as if it were a dissolution, destructive to Vanaras and Rakshasas.

40015769.author: पदार्थः
40015769.content: ततः thereafter, तत्र there, परमदारुणे exceedingly fearsome, तस्मिन् तमसि in that dark night, तेराक्षसाः those Rakshasas, सम्हृष्टाः highly delighted, शरवृष्टिभिः rain of arrows, राममेव Rama himself, अभ्यवर्तन्त assailed.

40015769.author: Translation
40015769.content: Thereafter in that exceedingly fearsome dark night in the battlefield highly delighted Rakshasas assailed Rama with a rain of arrows.

40015770.author: पदार्थः
40015770.content: क्रुद्धानाम् angry Rakshasas, गर्जताम् thundering, आपतताम् rushing towards, तेषाम् them, शब्दः noise, सत्त्वानाम् seven seas, उद्वर्ते risen to flow, समुद्राणाम् into ocean, प्रशुश्रुवे heard.

40015770.author: Translation
40015770.content: The thundering noise of the angry Rakshasas rushing towards Rama was like the seven seas rising to flow into the ocean.

40015771.author: पदार्थः
40015771.content: तेषां their, रामश्शरैः Rama's shafts, षडिभः six, षडजघान striking the six best, निशाचरान् Rakshasas, निमेषान्तरमात्रेण in the time of twinkling of eyelid, शितैरग्निशिखोपमै like flames, दुर्धर्षः difficult to overcome, यमशत्रुश्च Yamastru, महापार्श्वमहोदरौ Mahaparva, Mahodara, महाकायः Mahakaya, वज्रदंष्ट्रः Vajradamshtra, तौ them, उभौ both, शुकसारणौ Suka, Sarana, ते they, रामेण by Rama, बाणौघैः fire of arrows, सर्वमर्मसु vital parts, ताडिताः pierced by, तत्र there, युद्धात् from tha battle, अपसृताः escaped, सावशेषायुषः with left over life, अभवन् remained.

40015771.author: Translation
40015771.content: On Rama striking with the six best of shafts like flames in a time of twinkling of eyelids, the six Rakshasas, Yamasatru, Mahaparva, Mahodara, Mahakaya, and Vajradamshtra found it difficult to overcome. Along with the two Suka, Saranas all of them were struck by Rama's fire like arrows in their vital parts and escaped with leftover life.

40015772.author: पदार्थः
40015772.content: तेषां their, रामश्शरैः Rama's shafts, षडिभः six, षडजघान striking the six best, निशाचरान् Rakshasas, निमेषान्तरमात्रेण in the time of twinkling of eyelid, शितैरग्निशिखोपमै like flames, दुर्धर्षः difficult to overcome, यमशत्रुश्च Yamastru, महापार्श्वमहोदरौ Mahaparva, Mahodara, महाकायः Mahakaya, वज्रदंष्ट्रः Vajradamshtra, तौ them, उभौ both, शुकसारणौ Suka, Sarana, ते they, रामेण by Rama, बाणौघैः fire of arrows, सर्वमर्मसु vital parts, ताडिताः pierced by, तत्र there, युद्धात् from tha battle, अपसृताः escaped, सावशेषायुषः with left over life, अभवन् remained.

40015772.author: Translation
40015772.content: On Rama striking with the six best of shafts like flames in a time of twinkling of eyelids, the six Rakshasas, Yamasatru, Mahaparva, Mahodara, Mahakaya, and Vajradamshtra found it difficult to overcome. Along with the two Suka, Saranas all of them were struck by Rama's fire like arrows in their vital parts and escaped with leftover life.

40015773.author: पदार्थः
40015773.content: तेषां their, रामश्शरैः Rama's shafts, षडिभः six, षडजघान striking the six best, निशाचरान् Rakshasas, निमेषान्तरमात्रेण in the time of twinkling of eyelid, शितैरग्निशिखोपमै like flames, दुर्धर्षः difficult to overcome, यमशत्रुश्च Yamastru, महापार्श्वमहोदरौ Mahaparva, Mahodara, महाकायः Mahakaya, वज्रदंष्ट्रः Vajradamshtra, तौ them, उभौ both, शुकसारणौ Suka, Sarana, ते they, रामेण by Rama, बाणौघैः fire of arrows, सर्वमर्मसु vital parts, ताडिताः pierced by, तत्र there, युद्धात् from tha battle, अपसृताः escaped, सावशेषायुषः with left over life, अभवन् remained.

40015773.author: Translation
40015773.content: On Rama striking with the six best of shafts like flames in a time of twinkling of eyelids, the six Rakshasas, Yamasatru, Mahaparva, Mahodara, Mahakaya, and Vajradamshtra found it difficult to overcome. Along with the two Suka, Saranas all of them were struck by Rama's fire like arrows in their vital parts and escaped with leftover life.

40015774.author: पदार्थः
40015774.content: महारथः mighty, तत्रकाञ्चनचित्रङ्गैः decorated with gold, शरैः shafts, अग्निशिखोपमैः like the flames of fire, दिशश्च in all the directions, प्रदिशश्च brightened, विमलाः bright, चकार created.

40015774.author: Translation
40015774.content: Mighty Rama with his shafts that were like flames of fire, decorated with gold, brightened in all directions.

40015775.author: पदार्थः
40015775.content: रामस्य Rama's, अभिमुखे in front, स्थिताः stood, अन्ये other, ये who so ever, भीमा fierce, राक्षसाः Rakshasa, तेऽपि be it, पावकम् fire, आसाद्य fallen, पतङ्गाःइव like fireflies, नष्टाः destroyed.

40015775.author: Translation
40015775.content: Those fierce Rakshasas who stood in front of Rama were destroyed like fireflies fallen in fire.

40015776.author: पदार्थः
40015776.content: सहस्रशः thousands, सम्पतद्भिः raining, सुवर्णपुङ्खैः golden feathered, विशिखैः arrows, रजनी night, खद्योतैः illumined by fireflies, शारदीव in autumnal, चित्रा wonderful, बभूव appeared.

40015776.author: Translation
40015776.content: By the rain of thousands of golden feathered arrows, the night appeared as if illumined by fireflies and like a wonderful autumnal night.

40015777.author: पदार्थः
40015777.content: घोरा fierce, सानिशा that night, तदा then, राक्षसानाम् Rakshasas, हरीणाम् Vanaras, निस्स्वनैःच making noise, भूयः appeared, घोरतरा more dreadful, बभूव was.

40015777.author: Translation
40015777.content: The night which was fierce appeared more dreadful with the loud noise of Rakshasas and Vanaras.

40015778.author: पदार्थः
40015778.content: समन्ततः all over, प्रवृद्धेन risen, महता huge, तेन by that, शब्देन sound, कन्धराकीर्णः groups of caves, त्रिकूटःअचलः Trikuta mountain, प्रव्याहरदिव responded as if it was someone's call.

40015778.author: Translation
40015778.content: Resounding with the sound rising all over the caves of Trikuta mountain echoed and it looked as if the mountain was responding to someone's call.

40015779.author: पदार्थः
40015779.content: महाकायाः of gigantic body, तमसा dark complexioned, तुल्यवर्चसः highly energetic, गोलाङ्गूलाः endowed with long tails and black face, बाहुभ्याम् with their shoulders, सम्परिष्वज्य holding, रजनीचरान् Rakshasas, भक्षयन् allowed to be devoured.

40015779.author: Translation
40015779.content: The dark complexioned Rakshasas of gigantic body, who were highly energetic were held tightly by the monkeys with black faces and long tails and allowed them to be devoured.

40015780.author: पदार्थः
40015780.content: रणे in war, शत्रून् enemies, निहन्तुम् killing, समुपस्थितः who stood determined, अङ्गदस्तु Angada's, आशु in no time, रावणिम् Ravana's, सारथिंच charioteer, हयानपि horses also, निजघान wounded.

40015780.author: Translation
40015780.content: Angada who was determined to kill the enemies, in no time wounded Ravana's charioteer and also the horses.

40015781.author: पदार्थः
40015781.content: तदा then, घोरे terrific, भृशदारुणे violent, सङ्ग्रामे from the battlefield, अङ्गदेन by Angada, हताश्वः horses being killed, हतसारथिः charioteer killed, महामायः great cheater, इन्द्रजित्तु Indrajith, तत्स्रैव himself, अन्तरधीयत disappeared.

40015781.author: Translation
40015781.content: As the violent war was going on, the great cheat, Indrajith disappeared from there as Angada had already killed his horses and charioteer.

40015782.author: पदार्थः
40015782.content: तदा then, घोरे terrific, भृशदारुणे violent, सङ्ग्रामे from the battlefield, अङ्गदेन by Angada, हताश्वः horses being killed, हतसारथिः charioteer killed, महामायः great cheater, इन्द्रजित्तु Indrajith, तत्स्रैव himself, अन्तरधीयत disappeared.

40015782.author: Translation
40015782.content: As the violent war was going on, the great cheat, Indrajith disappeared from there as Angada had already killed his horses and charioteer.

40015783.author: पदार्थः
40015783.content: पूजनार्हस्य one who deserves to be worshipped, वालिपुत्रस्य Vali's son's, तत् कर्म that deed, सहर्षिभिः even sages, सर्वे all, देवाः deities, उभौ both, रामलक्ष्मणौ Rama and Lakshman, तुष्टुवुः praised.

40015783.author: Translation
40015783.content: Angada who was worthy of worship, was praised by even the sages, all deities and both Rama and Lakshmana for his action.

40015784.author: पदार्थः
40015784.content: युधि in war, इन्द्रजितः Indrajith, प्रभावम् deeds, सर्वभूतानि all beings, विदुः knew, तेन therefore, महात्मानम् great, ते his, प्रधर्षितम् gratified, तं him, दृष्टवा seeing, तुष्टाः rejoiced.

40015784.author: Translation
40015784.content: All beings present in war were aware of Indrajith's deeds. Therefore, they were gratified to see him defeated.

40015785.author: पदार्थः
40015785.content: ततः thereafter, ससुग्रीवविभीषणाः Sugriva and Vibheeshana, कपयः all monkeys, शत्रुम् enemy, प्रधर्षितम् gratification, दृष्टवा seeing, प्रहृष्टाः rejoiced, साधुसाध्विति excellent well done, नेदुश्च cried out.

40015785.author: Translation
40015785.content: Thereafter, Sugriva, Vibheeshana and all monkeys gratified with Angada's deed cried out saying "Excellent, Well done".

40015786.author: पदार्थः
40015786.content: तदा then, भीमकर्मणा of terrible deeds, तेनवालिपुत्रेण by Vali's son Angada, सम्युगे in the combat, निर्जितः defeated, इन्द्रजित्तु Indrajith, सुदारुणम् terrible, क्रोधम् anger, चक्रे turned.

40015786.author: Translation
40015786.content: Then Indrajith of terrible deeds defeated by Angada in the comb at became terribly angry.

40015787.author: पदार्थः
40015787.content: पापः sinful, रणकर्कशः capable of encounter, सःरावणि that Ravana, अदृश्यः rising up, अशनिवर्चसः remaining invisible, निशितान् sharp arrows, बाणान् by arrows, मुमोच remained.

40015787.author: Translation
40015787.content: That sinful son of Ravana, who is capable of encountering rising up remained invisible and shot sharp arrows.

40015788.author: पदार्थः
40015788.content: क्रुद्धः angry, समरे in war, घोरैः terrific, नागमयैः full of serpents, शरैः arrows, राक्षसः Rakshasa, रामंच at Rama, लक्ष्मणंचैव and Lakshmana, सर्वगात्रेषु all over the body, बिभेद pierced.

40015788.author: Translation
40015788.content: The angry Rakshasa (remaining invisible) pierced arrows full of serpents all over the body of Rama and Lakshmana.

40015789.author: पदार्थः
40015789.content: कूटयोधी waging war incognito, निशाचरः Rakshasa, तत्र there, युधि in war, मयया by supernatural power, सम्वृतः surrounded, राघवौ Raghava, मोहयन् in delusion, सर्वभूतानाम् all beings, अदृश्यः, भ्रातरौ brothers, रामलक्ष्मणौ Rama and Lakshman, शरबन्धेन network of arrows, बबन्ध bound.

40015789.author: Translation
40015789.content: The Rakshasa waging war in invisible form with all beings by his supernatural powers fought with both the brothers, Rama and Lakshmana and bound them in a network of arrows.

40015790.author: पदार्थः
40015790.content: तदा then, वानराः Vanara, क्रुद्धेन by angry, तेन their, आशीविषैः like venomous monkeys, शरैः arrows, सहसा forcibly, अनिहतौ bound, वीरौ warriors, पुरुषव्याघ्रौ tigers among men, तौ they both, प्रैक्षन्त beheld.

40015790.author: Translation
40015790.content: Then the Vanaras beheld the two brothers, tigers among men bound forcibly by the angry Rakshasas like venomous monkeys.

40015791.author: पदार्थः
40015791.content: तदा then, राक्षसराजपुत्रः Rakshasa king's son, प्रकाशरूपः bright form, तौ both, बाधितुम् to bind, नशक्तः incapable, मायाम् deceitfully, प्रयोक्तुम् using, समुपाजगाम remaining invisible, दुरात्मा evil minded, तौ both, राजसुतौ king's sons, बबन्ध bound.

40015791.author: Translation
40015791.content: Then the evil minded Rakshasa king's son, being incapable of getting bound in visible form, by remaining invisible, bound them deceitfully. ।। इत्यार्षेवाल्मीकीयेश्रीमद्रामायणेआदिकाव्येयुद्धकाण्डेचतुश्चत्वारिंशस्सर्गः ।। This is the end of the forty fourth sarga of Yuddha Kanda of the first epic the holy Ramayana composed by sage Valmiki.
